scope: Offline optional CLI/control-wait wrapper and substitutes only; no USB preparation, device access or Windows execution

provenance.run: AutoShop15f36b0 singleSet1;15f37b2 limit500;15f37c9 GetGCM;15f38b6 raw1 success;15f38d8 Sleep10ms
provenance.stop: AutoShop44e49e singleSet0;44e4ca..520 limit10, Sleep100ms, GetGCM untilraw0

deadline.scope: one absolute monotonic wait window shared across all independent reads
deadline.overrun: recorded; even late target never marks on-time success
deadline.native_resource_calls: enumeration/open/claim/release have no libusb timeout parameter; hard interruption not claimed
deadline.minimum_stop_window: Explicit0.1s STOP starts with immediate observation rather than spending entire budget sleeping; default STOP keeps initial100ms delay

evidence.control: full independent ACK/failure report and start/finish timestamps retained
evidence.reads: each full fixed-native GCM report, target, raw request/response, timeout and wall/monotonic start/finish retained
evidence.identity: fresh BUS:ADDRESS/VID:PID/bcdDevice cross-check; permanent identity unknown; lease released/reacquired per operation
evidence.cpu_state_verified: only correlated target state observed within deadline on matching descriptor/location

failures: Writer failure or missing correlated ACK: no polling
Any one read failure/interruption: stopunknown immediately, no later read or writer replay
Valid non-target0..3: may perform next new fixed read within same budget
Identity/product/release mismatch, invalid/bool state or uncorrelated result: stopunknown
Deadline/read budget exhaustion: failed state-wait-timeout with last observed state, never automatic RUN/STOP/clear/recovery

tests.kind: Mock control/fixed-reader, deterministic clock/sleep and C-ABI substitute regression; zero physical state transition tests
